candidate_sentence_map.S1: During the first three months of 2026, AS Amber Latvijas balzams reported an unaudited net turnover of EUR 11.1 million, which is a decrease of 29.6% compared to EUR 15.8 million in the corresponding period of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total sales volume declined by 36.1% to 517,600 nine-liter cases from 810,079 nine-liter cases in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Gross profit fell by 66.5% to EUR 1.2 million, down from EUR 3.5 million in the first three months of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The company recorded an operating loss of EUR 1.6 million for the reporting period, representing a significant decline from an operating profit of EUR 0.6 million in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Consequently, the net result shifted from a profit of EUR 0.9 million in the first three months of 2025 to a net loss of EUR 1.4 million in the first three months of 2026, resulting in a negative earnings per share of EUR 0.19 compared to EUR 0.11 in the prior period.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The financial performance was heavily impacted by external geopolitical and market conditions.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: The global spirits market experienced a downturn marked by lower sales volumes and changing consumer habits.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Furthermore, following Amber Beverage Group's support for Ukraine, Russian authorities designated related entities as extremist and confiscated the group-owned Talvis distillery.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: In January 2026, the Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings and the appointment of a trustee for Stoli Group USA led to a complete loss of control over operations within the U.S. jurisdiction, directly affecting the solvency of the company's largest customer and its ability to meet creditor obligations.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: These cash flow difficulties resulted in delayed excise tax payments and subsequent freezing of company bank accounts by the State Revenue Service.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: To ensure business continuity and protect creditors, the company filed an application on 30 January 2026 for legal protection proceedings, which was approved by the Riga City Court on 5 February 2026, allowing the company to restructure liabilities and stabilize operations.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: This filing automatically triggered events of default for the principal shareholder, Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l., under its bond documentation and bank financing arrangements.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Subsequently, the principal shareholder was authorized to initiate judicial reorganization proceedings in Luxembourg with a moratorium granted until 24 August 2026, suspending enforcement actions and events of default under the bonds.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: In operational efficiency indicators, the Right First Time rate improved to 99.5% from 98.4%, while the On Time In Full rate declined to 70.3% from 97.5%.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: The company also paid EUR 8.4 million in total taxes during the reporting period, including EUR 6.4 million in excise tax.
